heading.title: Provisions as to Bail and Bonds

article.title: Power to direct levy of amount due on certain recognizances
article.content:
496Power to direct levy of amount due on certain recognizances

Section 496 · Chapter XXXV
The High Court or Court of Session may direct any Magistrate to levy the amount due on a bond for appearance or attendance at such High Court or Court of Session.
